_comment: The Spanish roster venues scraped off taquilla.com (services.cinemas.es.TaquillaClient) instead of SensaCine, which stays their fallback. WRITTEN by data/spain/scripts/harvest_taquilla.py (this comment survives a rerun); generate_own_sources.py turns it into SpanishOwnSourcesData.scala.

Measured 2026-10-12: 181 roster venues matched a Taquilla venue page (postcode + name), and a venue moves only where Taquilla is a SUPERSET of what showtimes.cc served that day — it reaches past SensaCine's last day AND carries >= 95% of SensaCine's sessions over the near fortnight. 56 did: 34 Yelmo, 9 Kinépolis, 6 mk2, 5 Neocine, IMF Ondara, Multicines El Hornillo (their calendars run to 2026-12-15..2027-06-05, SensaCine's to 2026-10-12..11-08), +2203 sessions past SensaCine's last day.

NOT moved: no Cinesa (Taquilla sells only four days of it); no venue SensaCine lists nothing for — Taquilla sold no day at any of them either; mk2 Palacio de Hielo, Multicine Atlántida and eight more that were thinner on the near days. Left out for review rather than guessed: two roster venues claiming one page (Yelmo Campanar E0248/E0773, Kinépolis Marbella E0390/E0427, Neocine Rex, Cinema Catalunya Terrassa, Florida Guridi) and two pages tying for one venue (Yelmo Las Arenas, Abc Gandia).
Per venue: path + venueId are what the client reads; the rest is the measurement that put it here.
